SpecAgent learns from experiments (built 2026-10-11): `negotiation-arena-kit/starter-kit/knowledge/EXPERIMENTS.md` (result sheet), `experiments.jsonl` (every game), `learned_playbook.json` (read by the agent via `spec.strategy.choose`). Run the lab with `python -m arena_kit.spec.lab run --variants ... --sessions N`; it replays recorded games first, so only diverging games use practice sessions.

**Why:** the user wants every new agent and session to start from past experiments and not repeat mistakes. Practice sessions are scarce, and the user's own count of what is left can be lower than `arena me` reports (2026-10-11: user said 120, API said 268), so take the user's figure as the cap.

**How to apply:** read EXPERIMENTS.md before proposing strategy changes, add new ideas as named variants with a hypothesis in `spec/strategy.py`, test them via the lab with a `--sessions` cap, and check the leave-one-out (`learned --holdout`) result before claiming a gain on hidden cases. The hosted suppliers are deterministic for identical e-mails (code-only games repeat exactly), but the P05 RFQ depends on timing.

input.description: Collect all hosted session replays into a CSV

input.command:
python3 -c "
import csv
rows=list(csv.DictReader(open('runs/all_replays.csv')))
print('no score:',sum(not r['score'] for r in rows), 'no deal:', sum(r['deal']=='False' for r in rows))
print([ (r['case'],r['sources']) for r in rows if not r['score']][:10])
for c in sorted({r['case'] for r in rows}):
  for r in [r for r in rows if r['case']==c][:3]: print(c, r['score'], r['replay_url'], r['sources'][:60])
"; git check-ignore -v runs/all_replays.csv

content.text:
Yes, the runs are saved. The arena replays a game at `https://arena.tacto.ai/replay/<session_id>`. I pulled every session ID I could find into one list: **302 games across 11 cases**, in [runs/all_replays.csv](runs/all_replays.csv). It has one row per game with the case, score, whether a deal was made, the replay link and the run it came from. Each case is sorted best score first.

**Best replay per case:**

| Case | Games | Best score | Replay | Run it came from |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| P01 | 30 | 0.941 | [8ffc168595182655](https://arena.tacto.ai/replay/8ffc168595182655) | best_replays |
| P02 | 28 | 0.507 | [136d81f9aa6fc78b](https://arena.tacto.ai/replay/136d81f9aa6fc78b) | best_replays (several runs tie) |
| P03 | 29 | 0.919 | [abad6d3c316cbf95](https://arena.tacto.ai/replay/abad6d3c316cbf95) | lab sweep-1 [base] (several runs tie) |
| P04 | 27 | 0.874 | [725bef96bcc43f2d](https://arena.tacto.ai/replay/725bef96bcc43f2d) | lab smoke [base] |
| P05 | 39 | 0.824 | [5ef69b0415fe7def](https://arena.tacto.ai/replay/5ef69b0415fe7def) | spec-practice-astra-final |
| P07 | 28 | 0.773 | [c0d536a599a46f42](https://arena.tacto.ai/replay/c0d536a599a46f42) | baseline / best_replays |
| P08 | 29 | 0.593 | [c2b8d829f03e3deb](https://arena.tacto.ai/replay/c2b8d829f03e3deb) | lab sweep-5 [deep_one_step] |
| P10 | 26 | 0.671 | [b05f015f822ea7e1](https://arena.tacto.ai/replay/b05f015f822ea7e1) | best_replays |
| P11 | 33 | 0.710 | [ab87895b8c54193d](https://arena.tacto.ai/replay/ab87895b8c54193d) | lab sweep-1 [base] |
| P18 | 32 | 0.513 | [e49dd56e19f19a55](https://arena.tacto.ai/replay/e49dd56e19f19a55) | lab sweep-4 [one_step] |
| D02 | 1 | 0.650 | [137147ac8199bf6d](https://arena.tacto.ai/replay/137147ac8199bf6d) | spec-sandbox-d02 |

**Where the runs are stored:**
- **Lab runs:** `knowledge/experiments.jsonl` (239 rows), with the full records in `runs/lab/<batch>/`. 83 of those rows have no session ID, so they have no replay link. These are most likely the games the lab screened by replaying recorded games instead of playing them on the arena.
- **Practice and sandbox runs:** `runs/spec-*/results.json`.
- **Older runs:** `runs/baseline/` and `runs/meso*/`, as text logs that contain the replay link.
- **Local simulator runs:** the S01–S03 cases in `runs/1011-*_sim-*` and `runs/spec-sim-*`. They point at `127.0.0.1` addresses that no longer work, so I left them out of the list.

**`runs/best_runs.json` and `runs/best_replays/` are out of date.** Later lab runs beat the saved best for four cases:

| Case | Saved best | Newer best |
|---|---|---|
| P05 | 0.781 | 0.824 |
| P08 | 0.549 | 0.593 |
| P11 | 0.672 | 0.710 |
| P18 | 0.419 | 0.513 |

I can refresh those files if you want. One P05 game in `meso` has no score saved.

The CSV is a new file that git isn't tracking yet. The script that builds it is in my scratchpad; if you want to rebuild the list after future runs, I can move it into `arena_kit/spec/`.
